definitions.rise: body z relative to post-settling t0; not proof of grasp
definitions.distance: EEF point to body origin, not fingertip/contact
definitions.clock: sample0 post settling; observed sample s follows actual action s-1
definitions.gripper: positive actual action[-1] requests closure, negative opening; not measured contact
definitions.stages: 3cm rise and10cm EEF distance are descriptive bins, separate from environment predicates
definitions.missing: No contacts, object quaternions, articulated drawer/door joint positions in continuous NPZ
definitions.In: LIBERO container contact and contain; no gripper-release or post-success-stability requirement
definitions.destination: When predicate references a region, destination is its recorded root body origin; this is not the articulated region pose
definitions.uncertainty: Exact discrete whole-task bootstrap of8 or36 observed tasks; excludes training-seed uncertainty; endpoints may differ from readback10000-sample Monte Carlo
definitions.milk_reference: Task31 milk falls about38.2cm after captured t0 in both arms before robot approach; for the six first-target losses, sample20 is a shared pre-approach resting reference. A28.scope: CPU arithmetic of registered stored A28 velocity predictions only, no new policy/native/rollout forward or training. Four train tasks and eight teacher conditions; first5 is a single-tau FM slice.

native_train_action_readback.scope: CPU native action_out readback on eight preregistered trained teacher captures only. Original source output projection plus captured public A0/B0. No new native/model forward, GPU, environment, gradients or held labels. Label offset +1; first5 valid real future positions only, no last-frame artificial labels. These are tau1 fixed-noise FM velocities, not 10-step actions. Bad public readout does not imply H lacks control information.

scope.request: Bounded read-only metadata/spec and five historical comparison families for parent analysis after conditional900.
scope.excluded: No held action/state labels read; no model imports/forward/gradient/environment/GPU, no dataset construction, no tracked edits, no proposed successor list.
scope.raw_result_readback: Recompute counts/per-task from specified pre-existing results rows; inherited previous native-supervision audit is explicitly marked.

distinctions: 36 is the current Writer gradient pool: 24 target plus 12 source meta tasks. Source pretraining used 71; this does not mean Writer meta-training used 71.
Each task has 50 teacher episodes. The 450-to-900 continuation repeats this same task and teacher pool; repeated episodes/queries are not new independent task mappings.
The 71 are audited specification IDs, not a proved count of statistically or semantically independent mappings. Same-language cross-scene groups and related-procedure groups exist.

Historical libero90_nonheld_meta_v1 protocol refers to the old target split and default 56/15 meta folds; its active wording is not authority to launch those gradients for the current graph. Current extra-task use requires a registered current design.
The 59 source IDs outside current 12 are the conservative available specification pool, not 59 automatically useful additions or an authorized successor.

B_five_historical_families.scope_note: This family answers which native/action semantic supervision has actually been tried. It is not claimed that every member showed the same current seen-gain pattern.

decision_constraints: Current seen115/144 versus91 and held140/400 versus137 establishes where observed gain concentrates; it does not distinguish insufficient task coverage, language mapping shortcuts, compiled-operator transfer, or other mechanisms by itself.

Four held gaps differ materially: butter-basket edge, open-then-place composition, changed multi-object selection plus scene, and truly new microwave insertion geometry. A single generic lack-of-diversity explanation discards this structure.

Historical added-task, co-update diversity, controlled relation support, learned static/video, and direct action-supervision interventions must constrain successor predictions. None licenses a claim that more tasks always help, that content is unnecessary, or that direct native beta supervision has already failed.

Metadata establishes opportunities and absence of registered targets, not what representation the network learned. Missing exact training edge has successful counterexamples; successful primitive support also failed to yield particular compositions.
Keep old split and initialization/consumer differences explicit; do not use historical score magnitudes as paired evidence for the new graph.

Coverage36 was a coupled split/support/clock intervention, not a matched support-only 24-to36 causal test. Adding remaining59 supplies concrete new scene/selector/relation mappings to Writer, but supplies neither any source basket goal nor In-microwave goal and does not force dynamics to be necessary.
